cross_session_immunization_bank.failure_mode: UTF-8 BOM (`\ufeff`) in DraftKings CSV exports or Python source files causing `KeyError: 'Position'` or `SyntaxError: U+FEFF`.
cross_session_immunization_bank.immunization_rule: Always read external CSVs and source files with `encoding='utf-8-sig'` and write canonical repo artifacts with clean `encoding='utf-8'`.

cross_session_immunization_bank.failure_mode: Windows Python 3.8+ `ctypes.CDLL` failing to resolve MinGW runtime DLLs (`libgomp-1.dll`, `libstdc++-6.dll`) outside pre-configured shells.
cross_session_immunization_bank.immunization_rule: Register `DLL_PATH.parent` and MinGW bin directories via `os.add_dll_directory()` before `ctypes.CDLL(str(DLL_PATH))`.

cross_session_immunization_bank.failure_mode: Duplicate NFL teams (e.g., `MIA` or `BUF` appearing twice) or alias team codes (`LA` vs `LAR`, `WSH` vs `WAS`, `JAC` vs `JAX`) on a single slate.
cross_session_immunization_bank.immunization_rule: Normalize all team aliases first and run `assert_zero_duplicate_teams_or_players_on_slate()` raising `SlateIntegrityError(ValueError, RuntimeError)`.
